title: Adaptive rejection sampling
description: Samples the original Gaussian, negative half-Gaussian, and capture–recapture conditional targets; compares empirical densities with their mathematical targets.

reproduction.method: Tangent-envelope ARS with chord squeeze and exact exponential proposals
reproduction.description: Samples the original Gaussian, negative half-Gaussian, and capture–recapture conditional targets; compares empirical densities with their mathematical targets.
differences: Independent TypeScript conceptual reproduction; not execution or validation of the original MATLAB/Octave program.
1,000 rather than 20,000 accepted samples per target; analytic log derivatives replace finite-difference/secant hull construction.
Capture probabilities are seeded synthetic values in [0.1,0.9]; normalization/mean use finite [1,40] quadrature with the tail density reported.
Support knots are capped at 96; a frozen valid envelope still uses exact rejection correction.

checks.name: Tangent envelope dominates all evaluated targets
Gaussian mean agrees with E[X]=0 within six standard errors
Gaussian second moment agrees with E[X²]=1/2
Half-Gaussian samples obey the truncated support
Capture–recapture sample mean agrees with independent quadrature
